steps.what: Review the actual client information, source dates and relevant condition history
Evaluate the client's physical or mental condition from the evidence, resolving uncertainty within professional competence
Write and save the actual clinical condition evaluation with supporting references and limitations

tasks.design: Configure a dated source view in the clinical record {OTHER} and reuse its existing evaluation headings. The counselor retains source reading, condition evaluation and all substantive clinical writing; the ordinary save stays inside the writing step with no saving or approval gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant information may require repeated navigation across dated clinical entries.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views and existing note fields can remove some navigation and header entry.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence may conflict or fall outside the counselor's competence; interpretation and appropriate clarification remain professional work.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor understands context, uncertainty and the limits of the available evidence.

ambition.what: The same evidence-based condition evaluation remains a human responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical-record views and existing note fields can reduce navigation and repeated identifiers, while condition evaluation remains professional judgement.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual clinical/case-record system. Boundary covers information review, evaluation and the actual clinical entry used by the care team; it does not invent a new report or automatic diagnosis.

The existing treating professionals produce client ID, source author, observation date, reported/direct-observation status, original note reference and relevant history. s1 retains reading, source checking and manual retrieval of missing records; s2 retains evaluation and clarification. No new structured diagnosis feed or free capture is assumed.

Try the current record's native dated view and note fields first. s1 removes 4.2 of 35 units of repeated opening and navigation, retaining 30.8 for reading and checking. s3 removes only 1 of 20 units of repeated client/date headings; all clinical explanation, limitations and source checks retain 19. Estimates are unmeasured task designs.

Ordinary persistence occurs within s3 at near-zero time, fully retained without an author approval stage. No external disclosure, formal order or automated clinical action is proposed. Actual future disclosures require their own release action.

Clinical access and applicable national consultation requirements must be established. Revised views and broken-reference repair beyond normal case checking are counted as upkeep; no conversation recording or model is needed.
unknowns: Existing dated views and auto-filled headings
Actual navigation versus substantive review time
Clinical access and existing evaluation-note use
research_questions: Observe the actual information review and clinical entry separately.
Test conflicting dates and missing source notes without concealing uncertainty.

already_counted.description: Source reading, condition evaluation, actual clinical writing and ordinary persistence remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain dated reference views and note headings and repair broken source links beyond normal case checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=30.8+45+19=94.8. Gross 5.2 less 1 upkeep gives net 4.2. Conservative case: older scanned entries require 34.5 of 35 review units and a nonstandard evaluation needs 19.5 of 20 writing units. One gross unit just covers upkeep; clinical judgement is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the supervisee's actual case questions, prior supervision actions and role requirements
Supervise the counselor, service staff member, assistant or graduate student through actual discussion and observation
Write and save the existing supervision action entry used at the next supervision review

tasks.design: Link the actual prior supervision actions and role references in {DOCS}. The counselor retains preparation reading, live supervision, judgement and the existing follow-up entry; the small change only reduces repeated reference navigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual prior actions and relevant role references can be stored separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document links can bring those references together without creating staff monitoring or scoring.
tasks.still_hard: Feedback, clinical oversight, confidence and professional development depend on the person and actual work.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor notices uncertainty, challenges reasoning and supports the supervisee appropriately.

ambition.what: The same supervision relationship and professional oversight remain.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: links to existing supervision actions and role references can reduce repeated retrieval without replacing professional supervision.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual supervision preparation, conversation/observation and the action entry already read at the next review. Do not create a new personnel score, summary or record nobody uses.

The supervisee supplies actual case questions through the existing supervision process, and the supervisor's existing prior entry supplies action, responsible person and review point. s1 retains source reading and actual case preparation; s2 retains all feedback and clarification. {OTHER} means the clinical context system used under existing access permissions, not a new monitoring tool.

Test existing document links first. s1 removes only 1.2 of 15 units of repeated locating, retaining 13.8 for preparation; no fixed cut is applied to supervision. s3 is fully retained actual writing, including negligible same-system save without self-approval or saving. Shares are unmeasured estimates.

Where supervision is oral and has no existing action record, do not add one or claim a saving from it. The proposed gain is reference navigation only. Other participants' supervision time remains unchanged and is not transferred into this role's saving.
Broken links and reference upkeep beyond actual case preparation are counted below; no model, transcription or automatic staff assessment is proposed.
unknowns: Actual use of a prior action record
Navigation time within genuine supervision preparation
research_questions: Observe actual supervision and confirm what prior material is really read.
Check the reference view does not expose unrelated client information or add staff scoring.

already_counted.description: Supervision preparation, conversation/observation and the actual follow-up action entry remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain the few supervision reference links and repair broken references beyond normal preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=13.8+80+5=98.8. Gross 1.2 less 0.5 upkeep gives net 0.7. Conservative case: new supervisee questions use unfamiliar references, retaining 14.5 of 15 preparation units. The 0.5 gross gain only covers upkeep; supervision and existing action writing are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual patient's current therapy goals and previously discussed transition concerns
Discuss the individual patient's plans, concerns and understanding of life after leaving therapy
Write and save the actual clinical entry about the discussion of life after therapy

tasks.design: Test the clinical record's {OTHER} existing goal links for the small pre-discussion lookup. Keep the conversation and the brief clinical entry human: the small navigation benefit is consumed by maintaining the links.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior therapy goals and transition concerns can require an extra record opening.
tasks.enabler_now: A native goal link may remove that small repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: The patient's expectations, feelings and plans require a responsive therapeutic conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor listens, explores meaning and helps the patient articulate their own plans.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native clinical goal link can reduce a small retrieval action but does not replace discussion or ensure a useful net time saving.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual clinical record. Boundary includes real pre-discussion reading, the therapeutic conversation and its existing brief clinical entry read during ongoing care. No additional aftercare report or referral is invented.

The treating counselor's existing record supplies client ID, current goal and prior transition-note date/reference. s1 retains all substantive reading and any missing-source lookup; s2 produces the discussion content and s3 captures the actual brief note. No transcript or new structured observation input is assumed.

Native goal links are tested before any custom tool. They remove only 0.5 of 10 lookup units, retaining 9.5; s3 stays fully manual because a brief patient-specific note still needs actual capture and meaning checks. No drafting benefit is presumed from a hypothetical admin baseline.
Ordinary same-system save is included in s3 at near-zero retained time, ungated and without a saving. No external message or formal treatment change is hidden in the conversation.

After separating lookup and actual note writing from conversation, the 0.5 gross gain is offset by 0.5 link maintenance. These are unmeasured estimates; a larger build is not justified by this task alone.
unknowns: Whether a prior-goal link already exists
Whether any additional link upkeep is needed
research_questions: Observe the actual transition discussion, lookup and brief note separately.
Confirm that an existing native link already solves the lookup before adding anything.

already_counted.description: Substantive context reading, the complete therapeutic discussion and actual brief-note writing/persistence remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain and repair the small transition-goal reference view beyond normal case reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=9.5+85+5=99.5. Gross 0.5 minus 0.5 upkeep gives net zero. Even when the goal link works, the actual substantive reading, conversation and short clinical entry remain; maintaining that link consumes the eligible navigation saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advocate for services and in crises

steps.what: Retrieve current service contacts and the available client context needed for advocacy
Act as the client's advocate directly with the client and professionals to coordinate services or resolve the crisis
outputs: actual advocacy actions and known response

steps.what: Write and save the actual clinical advocacy entry with actions, responses and unresolved service or crisis issues
inputs: actual advocacy actions and known response

tasks.design: Show maintained service contacts and available clinical context in {OTHER} with references from {DOCS}. Keep direct advocacy and factual capture human; the existing note template reuses only client/date/contact headings, with no automatic risk statement, care choice or dispatch.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual service references and clinical context may require repeated navigation, and notes repeat identifying fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and existing note fields can shorten those mechanical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual service availability, disclosure limits and changing crisis circumstances demand direct professional action.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor responds to the person, understands incomplete information and advocates with the real services involved.

ambition.what: Direct client advocacy and crisis response remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current contact references and clinical note fields can reduce navigation and identifying-field entry without automating client advocacy or crisis response.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual clinical/case-record system. Boundary includes current reference lookup, direct service/crisis advocacy and the clinical entry actually used by the care team. Do not add a separate service report, risk score or transcript.

The current care team supplies existing client context; the actual service-directory owner supplies service, contact, coverage and last verification date. s1 counts real reading, checking and manual fallback lookup. No live capacity feed or free structured crisis input is assumed.

s2 retains all direct advocacy, current disclosure checks, live calls and clarification. Reference lookup must never delay emergency intervention. This is real-time professional communication, not a hidden automated written send or dispatch; any actual formal dispatch or disclosure packet needs a separate action and authority.

Test native views and templates first. s1 removes 2 of 10 repeated navigation units. s3 removes only 1.2 of 15 units of repeated client, date and contact headings, retaining 13.8 for factual capture, chronology, unresolved issues and full source checks. These are unmeasured estimates, not a flat cut on clinical work.

The existing clinical entry records actual actions after they occur and is read for ongoing care. Ordinary same-system save stays in s3 at near-zero fully retained time, ungated and without an author approval stage or gain. Reference/field repair beyond case checks is counted below.
unknowns: Actual service-reference owner and current links
research_questions: Observe actual advocacy, contact lookup and clinical entry separately.
Test an unavailable contact and uncertain outcome without delaying live intervention or recording an invented resolution.

already_counted.description: Context/contact reading, all direct advocacy and actual clinical entry/checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain service-reference links and existing note fields and repair broken references beyond normal case checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=8+75+13.8=96.8. Gross 3.2 minus 1 upkeep gives net 2.2. Conservative case: an unfamiliar service retains 9.5 of 10 lookup units and an unusual crisis needs 14.5 of 15 note units. The 1 gross unit just covers upkeep; advocacy is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Client evaluation, therapy discussion, supervision and advocacy retain their professional judgement. Native references and the fields actually used in existing records can remove only limited repeated work.
skills_to_grow: Keep dated sources visible in clinical reasoning
Distinguish ordinary record persistence from actual external disclosure
Test whether a small configuration earns its upkeep
role.ambitious_version: Keep clinical and supervision records tied to the actual work, with clear uncertainty and no extra paperwork created merely to automate it.
